title: introduce-shadow-eval-with-time-decay-weighted-regression-gate
author: Ishaan Rao
description: Motivation: production prompt sets can become brittle when anchors are treated as static baselines. This PR implements a shadow-eval pipeline that runs candidate prompt/model combinations against a sampled mirror of production traffic and introduces a decay-weighted regression gate for CI. The decay-weighted gate reduces false-positive regression signals from stale anchors by applying a time-decay to historical anchor scores and combining them using an ensemble weighting scheme. Key goals: 1) Surface true regressions earlier with fewer noisy alerts, 2) allow continuous shadow validation against recent traffic without blocking canary rollouts, 3) provide actionable attribution for prompt- or model-driven regressions. What changed: - New shadow evaluation worker that consumes a sampled, privacy-safe traffic stream and records per-prompt metrics (latency, semantic-match, tokenization failures, hallucination score) in the eval DB. - Decay-weighted regression gate implemented as a CI hook that computes a weighted baseline from historical anchors using exponential decay (configurable half-life per cohort). - Introduced an aggregator that fuses live shadow metrics with scheduled cohort evals to produce a stability score and an optional soft-fail that annotates PRs instead of hard-blocking when sensitivity is low. - New telemetry (meter, tracer spans) and dashboards for shadow load, decay factor distribution, and gate firings. - Config knobs: half_life_days, min_anchor_samples, shadow_sample_rate, soft_fail_threshold. Implementation notes: - The decay logic is implemented in eval-harness/src/hook/decay_gate.py and is covered by unit and integration tests. - The shadow worker is a new process entrypoint in eval-harness/src/shadow/worker.py and supports dry-run vs active modes. - To avoid noisy alerts for low-volume cohorts, the gate includes a minimum-sample check and a stability damping term. Testing and rollout: - Unit tests added for decay math, weighting, and fusion logic. - Integration test simulating anchor drift and verifying gate behavior across half-life configurations. - Shadow pipeline tested end-to-end on synthetic traffic; initial rollout plan is opt-in for the top-20 prompt sets by traffic volume for two weeks. Caveats: - Shadow sampling adds modest extra cost; default sample_rate is 0.1% and can be tuned per org. - This PR does not change existing blocking gates; decay-gate is introduced as an opt-in CI hook until monitored for 2 weeks. Related work: ENG-4309 (anchor-serializer improvements), ENG-4610 (cohort telemetry standardization).

review_comments: Maya Patel: This looks promising — can you explain how the half_life_days interacts with our rolling baseline? I'm worried very short half-lives may oscillate.
Luca Moretti: Please add an opt-out flag at the org level; some customers will not want any shadow traffic to be mirrored even anonymized.
Ruth Kim: The telemetry labels look good; add span attributes for 'anchor_age_days' and 'weight_contribution' to make debugging gate firings easier.
CI Bot: e2e-eval failed on first run (timeout in shadow worker) — flake suspected, rerun recommended.
author_replies: Ishaan Rao: Answered Maya — default half_life_days=14 and gate computes a damped rolling baseline; added unit test to demonstrate non-oscillatory behavior for half_life_days >= 3. See test_decay_gate.py:TestDampedRollingBaseline.
Ishaan Rao: Added org-level opt_out=true flag in ops config and an environment variable REDWOOD_SHADOW_OPT_OUT that gates worker startup. Documented in decay_gate.md.
Ishaan Rao: Added requested span attributes and updated Grafana panels to display weight breakdown per-anchor-age.
Ishaan Rao: CI e2e timeout was due to synthetic traffic generator; increased test timeout and added retry logic. Re-ran CI and all checks passed.
release_notes: Introduce an opt-in shadow evaluation worker and a decay-weighted regression CI gate to reduce noisy regressions from stale anchors. Configurable half-life and sampling rate. Adds telemetry and dashboards. Rollout: opt-in for high-volume prompt sets; no blocking changes to existing gates.
post_merge_actions: Schedule 2-week monitoring window for top-20 prompt-sets
Add runbook entry for decay-gate firings in SRE playbook
Backfill metrics for last 90 days for weight distribution analysis
